“`

“The Eighth Stage of Martial Arts should correspond to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage in the Immortal Cultivation System, right?”

Lin Yuan thought of the Immortal Cultivation System.

The Transcendence Tribulation Stage is also known as the Immortal King.

Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King.

Even when surveying the three thousand Dao provinces of the Spirit Realm, the Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King stands at the absolute summit.

...

“To step into the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, one must transcend both the Heart Demon Tribulation and the Bodily Tribulation, only then can one break through to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage and assume the position of an Immortal King.”

“This is similar to the need to overcome the Heart Demon Tribulation when advancing from the Seventh Rank to the Eighth Rank.”

Lin Yuan pondered in his heart.

The difference is that advancing from the Seventh Rank to the Eighth Rank only requires overcoming the Heart Demon Tribulation, whereas the True Immortals of Dao Integration in the Spirit Realm must also face an additional Bodily Tribulation.

“Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings, wielding the Power of Creation, overlooking the Spirit Realm, and even capable of divine travel through hundreds of thousands of Lower Realms?”

Lin Yuan thought of what he had read about the Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings.

This information was collected by the Martial Temple. Although the Martial Dao Cultivation System is different from the Immortal Cultivation System, those who came later still hold the top-tier experts of Dao with awe.

“I wonder what the difference is between a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King and an Eighth Rank Evolver.” Lin Yuan was curious.

The cultivation system is different, so naturally, the abilities displayed at each stage are also different.

If a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King corresponds to the Eighth Rank, that’s only a rough equivalence in terms of combat power; as for the specific details and techniques, only a personal confrontation would tell.

“Power of Creation?”

Lin Yuan stroked his chin. This power is the core strength of a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King, the greatest confidence for Immortal King-level powerhouses to overlook all beings.

“Is it another term for the power of the world, or simply another type of energy? Do Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings not have their own Inner Worlds at all?”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts fluctuated.

The most powerful method of the Eighth Rank Evolvers is the power of the world cultivated within their Inner Worlds.

But as for the Power of Creation held by the Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings, its true nature remains unknown.

The Martial Temple’s level is after all not high; it cannot gather detailed information about the Immortal King-level powerhouses.

…

Deep within the Martial Temple.

Several Supreme Elders gathered together again.

“Chang Er’s talent is too strong; we’re unable to teach him anymore…”

The Second Supreme Elder was silent for a while before speaking the truth.

They are all martial practitioners of the Sixth Stage Martial Tao, equivalent to Ancient Saints of the Nether Refinement Period.

In the Spirit Realm, Ancient Saints of the Nether Refinement Period can also dominate a region. At least within a city like Xianyao City, a battle prowess of the Ancient Saints level is considered top-notch.

But facing Lin Yuan, they all felt a bit intimidated.

Lin Yuan’s learning capability and cultivation speed are too fast.

So fast that it made them doubt how they had lived through the years.

“So what should we do?”

The Third Supreme Elder asked.

“Now the only option is to ask the three ancestors for guidance. Perhaps only the three ancestors are qualified to teach Chang Er.”

The Great Supreme Elder spoke.

“The three ancestors?”

The remaining Supreme Elders were inwardly startled.

The three ancestors here naturally refer to the three Seventh Stage Martial Tao strong practitioners.

The founders of the Martial Temple.

However,

currently, these three Seventh Stage Martial Tao practitioners are all battling for the Daode Immortal Sect.

Daode Immortal Sect has protected Xianyao City for many years, not only because a True Immortal of considerable prominence within the sect negotiated an agreement with that mysterious Martial Ancestor,

but also because of the merits the three ancestors had established for the Daode Immortal Sect over the years.

“Now, it seems only the three ancestors can teach him.”

The Third Supreme Elder sighed. Anyway, they didn’t dare to continue teaching; otherwise, they would undoubtedly risk damaging their own state of mind.

It’s too exaggerated.

If they hadn’t confirmed that Lin Chang’s soul and body were perfectly integrated,

they would suspect that Lin Chang might have been seized by some old monster.

In the Spirit Realm, seizure is not an uncommon occurrence.

“I will contact the three ancestors right away.”

Seeing that the other Supreme Elders had no objections, the Great Supreme Elder stood up and said.

The three ancestors are engaged in external battles. If there is no major issue, they are not to be disturbed, but the matter concerning Lin Yuan is considered a major issue by the Supreme Elders.

…

Within the cave dwelling,

Lin Yuan, in addition to cultivating, was also sensing the Great Dao rules of the Spirit Realm.

“Taiyin Rule…”

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred, and streams of the extremely yin and pure Power of Taiyin converged in the depths of his pupils, merging with the Power of Taiyang to form the power of Taiji.

“I didn’t expect that not long after arriving, I would comprehend the Taiyin Rule.”

“`

Lin Yuan was in a good mood. Despite spending nearly twenty years in seclusion in the Main World without comprehending the Taiyin Rule, he had managed to grasp it not long after crossing over.

“However, my current strength is too weak to condense the rules. Otherwise, it would be interesting to see what will happen when the Taiyin Rule merges with the Taiyang Rule. Will it form a new rule? The Taiji Rule?”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

The rules of the Great Dao are elusive. To condense a certain rule, one must first thoroughly understand it, and second, possess a body and soul capable of carrying that rule.

Of course, Lin Yuan wasn’t able to condense the Taiyin Rule just yet, but he could still use it.

Once a certain rule is fully understood, even a mortal can, in every action, align with this rule and unleash a power that far exceeds their limits.

“This traversal does allow for the awakening of a new Physical Body Divine Ability…”

Lin Yuan seemed to think of something, and his eyes lit up slightly.

The Sixth Stage Martial Tao Chapter draws from the essence of Body Cultivation, enabling the condensation of Divine Physical Body Abilities that belong to a Martial Dao Cultivator.

So far, Lin Yuan had condensed two Physical Body Divine Abilities.

The first one is ‘Blood Rebirth’.

The second is ‘Mountain Moving’.

The former had brought tremendous help to Lin Yuan, even the opening of that mysterious gourd relied on the ‘Blood Rebirth’ ability.

“Then there’s that gourd…”

Lin Yuan’s consciousness sank into the depths of his mind, looking at the towering and massive Door to the Myriad Realms.

If Lin Yuan wished, he could use a strand of World-Breaking Origin Force at any time to bring over the mysterious gourd.

But after some thought, Lin Yuan decided to wait a while more.

His current strength was still too weak, and the mysterious gourd was too precious. It would be better to wait until he had sufficient power to protect himself in this world before considering it.

“Cultivate, cultivate.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts converged, and he started cultivating again.

Although he was under the protection of the Martial Temple now and did not need to worry about safety,

there were still many things waiting for Lin Yuan to do, and all these things required strength.

…

On the edge of the Xuanwang Domain.

Inside a palace.

Three figures were sitting cross-legged, their Qi and blood circulating and faintly vibrating in all directions.

“Hmm?”

“The Martial Temple has sent me a message.”

The first figure on the left opened his eyes and spoke.

“The Martial Temple?”

“Has something big happened?”

The first figure on the right also opened his eyes.

They had long told the Martial Temple not to contact them lightly unless something significant happened.

“What’s the matter?”

The figure in the middle opened her eyes and asked slowly.

This figure was a stunningly beautiful woman, who was none other than ‘Li Qing,’ the direct disciple Lin Yuan had once accepted.

“They say that the Martial Temple has received a once-in-an-age genius, who upon perceiving the Martial Ancestor’s Divine Radiance, caused seven divine statues to tremble, all aglow with twelvefold brilliance,” the figure on the left explained.

“All seven divine statues radiant with twelvefold brilliance?”

The tonality of the figure on the right wavered slightly.

Even he had only managed to make one divine statue tremble and shine with twelvefold brilliance back in his day.

“Indeed a once-in-an-age genius.”

Li Qing nodded and said, “What does the Martial Temple want us to do?”

“They want one of us to go back and personally instruct this genius,” the figure on the left said.

“Go back, one of us?” Li Qing frowned slightly.

“The battle with the other Great Realms is at a critical moment; we cannot leave, not even our Primordial Spirits can depart.”

“In that case, reply to the Martial Temple that in a hundred years, I will personally return to guide this once-in-an-age genius,” Li Qing said.

She valued martial arts geniuses highly; perhaps influenced by Lin Yuan in the past, Li Qing was willing to offer each Martial Dao Cultivator the chance to advance further.

“A hundred years?”

“Yes, in a hundred years, the conflict will mostly cease, and by then, the three of us can return to see for ourselves.”

“Let that once-in-an-age genius cultivate on their own for these hundred years, and when we return later, we will personally guide them,” the figure on the right said.

“No problem,” the figure on the left nodded.

A hundred years was nothing; that once-in-an-age genius might just be beginning to comprehend the Martial Dao. Their return would be just in time to provide guidance at a critical moment.

…

Years passed by.

In the blink of an eye, a hundred years had passed since Lin Yuan arrived in this world.
